8279.title: Cursor catalog curation prevents CLI discovery
8279.rootCauseOneLine: Cursor's fixed primary family list moves discovered nonmatching families into selectedOnlyModels; the CLI emits only primary models unless an exact selected-model ID is supplied.
8279.proposedFix: Choose an explicit catalog policy: expose all discovered families by default, or retain curated primary picks while adding a documented all-models enumeration path through the SDK and CLI. Avoid another one-off allowlist update.
8279.caveats: Two clean fixture-based command runs, not a live Cursor account or visual picker test. No fix PR: safe remediation requires a product choice about curation versus enumeration.
